title: UPDATE: LangChain Opens Stripe Link Agentic Payments to Developers
summary:
Automated agents built with LangChain now have the ability to process purchases and search for merchandise using the Stripe Link ecosystem. These agents can locate specific products and prepare carts, though a human must approve every order through the Stripe Link agent wallet and Slack before the transaction is finalized. The payment framework is built on Managed Deep Agents and the MPP protocol, allowing for both programmatic payments and standard online checkouts.

This expansion brings agentic payment capabilities to the broader enterprise developer community after a similar integration was first launched by Brainbase for internal corporate agents. While earlier AI agents such as Muse and Instinct focused on personal consumer purchases, these new tools from LangChain and Stripe are designed to scale payment-capable AI for corporate and enterprise environments.
